content: The function EthSwt_PortLinkStateRequest shall re- quest the given link state for the indexed Ethernet switch port of the switch by call- ing the EthTrcv_TransceiverLinkStateRequest with the given EthTrcv_- LinkStateType . If the EthSwtPort does not reference an EthTrcv, then the function shall return E_NOT_OK .
